usedFor: Short Menu shortens and tracks links, and “Create Short Link” builds one that redirects to a destination.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Received” in PayHere, then “Create Short Link” in Short Menu
bestTemplate.why: A short link can follow each payment, and the action creates it with an optional custom slug.

watchOut: “Create Short Link” can use a custom slug, so check the slug and destination before it runs.
